_comment: MechrevoChargeControl profile/encoding table. VERIFIED on this machine (WUJIE14SE, 2026-09-09) via instance-based calibration.

encodingConfirmed.dataMeaning: Data == charge cap percent (plain uint64, 0..100). 0 = limit inactive (charge to 100%).
encodingConfirmed.calibrationEvidence: Set 100 -> Get read back 0x64630000 (contains 0x64=100). Set 0 -> Get read back 0xFF0000 (0xFF = inactive marker byte, limit byte 0). before both writes: 0x0.
encodingConfirmed.callStyle: methods MUST be invoked through WMI instance ACPI\PNP0C14\HWMI_0 (class-level calls rejected). instance enumeration requires admin.
encodingConfirmed.observedWindowCap: 1..100 accepted by firmware readback; community range on WUJIE14XA: 60..100 verified in field, <60 untested there.
encodingConfirmed.liveTest20260909: Set 80% with AC adapter: charged at ~29 W until ~79% (OS rounding of 80), then charge rate dropped to 0 mW and percent parked ~79-80. charging flag stayed True while rate=0 - exactly the 'EC hides real charging state when a limit is active' behaviour documented in kernel docs; current/rate is the reliable indicator. Gate works on this unit (no WUJIE14XA stored-limit bug observed).
encodingConfirmed.modeChannelStatus: EmdAcpi_Battery_Charge_Mode::Battery_Charge_Mode(Data 0/1/2) NOT yet write-tested (would switch charging profile on 0x07A6). Leave inactive unless needed.

_officialEnumFromGCUService: Static reflection of GCUService.exe (namespace GCUService.MySystem). Health status and command values come from compiled enums, so these are NOT guesses.
_registerModelEvidence: Confirmed by mainline Linux drivers/platform/x86/uniwill/uniwill-acpi.c (read in full).

0x07A6.name: OEM_4 charging profile
0x07A6.note: bit6 of same byte is touchpad toggle - never overwrite whole byte

0x07B9.name: CHARGE_CTRL (charge up-limit)
0x07B9.note: 0 means inactive; reads of 0 treated as 100. Community range on WUJIE14XA: 60..100.

0x07C3.name: state/recovery trigger (community)
0x07C3.note: WUJIE14XA workaround: temporarily write 0x04 ~2s then restore, to force stored-limit sync

0x0742.name: gate/support register (community)
0x0742.note: bit2 set (value & 0x04) => charge-limit gate enabled; mainline calls this EC_ADDR_SUPPORT_5 (bits4/5 fan flags)

chargeLimitBug.appliesTo: Mechrevo WUJIE14XA family EC (stored-limit gate). Fixed by BIOS/EC >= N.1.14MRO19 (EC 2.08) or N.1.14MRO50 (EC 2.12).
chargeLimitBug.appliesToThisMachine: unknown - BIOS here is WUJIE14SE_SE4_APX336_7445HS Rev04 (newer platform, EC version unverified)
chargeLimitBug.warningSource: Linux kernel docs: threshold interface is broken on some devices and forcing it may damage the battery; kernel never enables charge-limit under force, charge profiles only.

_encodingHypotheses: H1: Data word == plain small integer. For SetBatteryChargeRationing likely percent 1..100 (mirrors 0x07B9). For Battery_Charge_Mode likely 0/1/2 (mirrors 0x07A6 profile) or percent. UNVERIFIED at the WMI layer - confirm with the elevated probe.
